# DriftSense Pilot

Find the right copy of a structure on a periodic semiconductor array, say how
sure you are, and let an agent re-image or ask a human instead of guessing.
DriftSense Pilot is an OpenCV 5 localisation engine (stages S0–S9), an
active-perception agent with runner-enforced safety gates and an MCP server, and
a web app on AWS with a Graviton worker built from the COOL 3.1 AMI.

- Devpost text: [SUBMISSION.md](SUBMISSION.md)
- Architecture and the OpenCV calls per stage: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- COOL on Graviton evidence: [docs/COOL_EVIDENCE.md](docs/COOL_EVIDENCE.md)
- Responsible use: [docs/RESPONSIBLE_USE.md](docs/RESPONSIBLE_USE.md)
- How numbers get into these docs: [docs/TEMPLATES.md](docs/TEMPLATES.md)

## Quickstart

Python 3.12 in a virtual environment:

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate   # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.lock && pip install -e . --no-deps
make test                      # pytest
```

Run an agent episode set on the virtual SEM (prints the four-arm summary;
`--no-write` keeps the committed results file untouched):

```bash
python eval/agent_eval.py --n 4 --no-write
```

MCP server over stdio (inspect it with the MCP Inspector):

```bash
python -m driftsense.agent.mcp_server
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector python -m driftsense.agent.mcp_server
```

Service end to end, in-process with mocked AWS (v2 engine plus the agent):

```bash
python -m service.e2e_local --engine v2 --agent
```

Web UI in development mode (Node 22):

```bash
cd ui && npm ci && npm run dev
```

Deploy to AWS (ap-south-1): see [infra/README.md](infra/README.md).

Docs: `python scripts/render_docs.py` regenerates every generated page from
`results/**/*.json`, and `python scripts/check_claims.py` fails if any number is
not traceable to a results file.

## Repository map

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `driftsense/v2/` | The OpenCV 5 engine, one module per stage |
| `driftsense/v1/` | Frozen prior work (MunichTech), the baseline |
| `driftsense/agent/` | Tools, rules policy, optional LLM planner, safe runner, MCP server |
| `driftsense/sim/` | The virtual SEM used for every result |
| `eval/` | Calibration, gates, sealed-run harness, agent evaluation |
| `results/` | Every number in the docs, as versioned JSON |
| `service/`, `infra/`, `ui/` | API and worker, CDK app, static web UI |
| `bench/` | The COOL on Graviton benchmark campaign |
| `scripts/` | Docs renderer and claims checker |

## History

This repository started as DriftSense v1 by MunichTech. The v1 code is frozen
in `driftsense/v1/`; its original README and results are preserved at the
[`v1-munichtech`](https://github.com/HUNT-001/DriftSense/tree/v1-munichtech)
tag. They describe the previous engine on its own test seeds and are not the
current results.
